title: specs/fsd/<doc>/table-map.yaml: which column of a document's table means what (C.2, D124)
description: A person writes or approves this. No AI proposes one yet. `fsd compare-tables` applies it; a table not named here is listed as unmapped, never silently passed.

table.description: A table's T- id or an attachment's A- id, from `fsd tables`.

sheet.description: An attachment's sheet, when it has more than one.

column.description: The column whose cells name the facts: its header, word for word.

target.description: api-field: a type's name or graph id, or `<VERB> <route> request` or `response`. enum-member: an enum's name or graph id.

valueColumn.description: enum-member only: the column holding each member's value, compared with the code's.

aliases.description: A name difference between the FSD and the code is declared here, and only here.

fsd.description: The name as the FSD's cell has it.

code.description: The name as the code has it.
